name: Neighborhood Missions
status: Unified release manifest. Actual publication and verification are recorded in the separate receipt; this manifest alone is not a deployment claim.
changes: Summonable world-fixed field desk with independently saved height, distance, scale and reduced-motion setting.
Compact in-canvas wrist or near-feet map and current mission goal in both districts.
Physical left/right-trigger riding options, with the old Action/Courier mapping still available and on-foot controls retained.
Native ray intersection dot and button highlight; large UI and rays hidden on resume.
Original city is the main entry; Lantern Ward is a district in the same document, renderer and active XR session.
Eight actual-geometry views in both districts: first/third-person AR/VR and first/third-person diorama AR/VR. No comfort-theater screen.
Room-fixed full-depth portal follows the player, with front/top/both apertures and shader ownership preventing duplicate GLSL.
Native maps, missions, control settings and cancel-first save menus; gameplay boards and residual flat HUDs hidden.
Hold-to-speed release braking and Menu access even before held gameplay controls return to neutral.
Resident stories, Signal Hijack and five sequential optional campaign cases with cape, holsters, stealth, counters, lunges and functional interiors.
Real arcade glide landing, supported upper-floor enemies and repaired floor/stair seams. All original save and reward identities retained.
